messages:
sam: quick usability check on the compact autoscale row — toggling burst currently shifts layout and hides the min field briefly. Fig: https://figma.com/file/compact-row

elaine: saw it. hiding min even for a second is confusing. users reported they thought the value reset.

priya: accessibility: motion + layout shift can be disorienting. prefer stable layout and cross-fade secondary controls instead of removing nodes.

omar: engineering note: we can animate opacity without reflow. cheaper and keeps focus targets stable.

a11y-bot: lint: animation should respect prefers-reduced-motion; ensure focus order remains consistent when controls appear.

sam: proposal: keep min/max visible always, move burst controls to a compact toggle chip that expands inline details below with smooth height transition.

elaine: copy tweak: change 'Burst' label to 'Burst (temporary capacity)' and add tooltip 'Short-lived extra GPUs for spikes.'

priya: also add SR text for the tooltip and ensure the expanded details are announced via aria-live polite.

omar: I'll implement the opacity transition and reduced-motion checks. also will add a small debounce so keyboard users don't accidentally toggle while arrow-keying numbers.

sam: final microcopy for expanded hint: 'Burst adds temporary GPUs during demand spikes. Charges apply while active.'

elaine: LGTM. thanks team, will update Figma and run a quick usability pass later today :thumbsup:
